architecture: Fine-tune last two MoLFormer Transformer layers and final LayerNorm, concatenate pooled representation with descriptor/MACCS branch, residual prediction head
training_augmentation: alternate both SMILES views; independent seeded weight initialization
inference: mean canonical and randomized SMILES predictions, then mean two seeds
numerical_precision: float32 inference; fixed float32 rotary cache up to max_tokens; bfloat16 training autocast
classification_loss: BCE logits plus 0.15 pairwise logistic ranking loss; no positive class weighting
regression_loss: MAE for MAE tasks; smooth L1 plus 0.15 pairwise ranking for Spearman
inner_selection: scaffold split using fit rows only, check every 2 epochs, patience 4 checks, refit entire fit set at chosen epoch
selection: maximize 0.6 mean OOF gain + 0.4 official valid gain - 0.025 fold std - 0.0002 candidate weight, relative MAE / absolute ranking metric gains
uncertainty: Scaffold OOF and validation reused across iterations; not an unbiased score forecast. The total-score formula is unavailable.
